programme.desc: Four friends enter the drug trade in Boston in the late 1970s: Tristan (Allen Payne), Money (Aaron D. Spears), E-Bone and Simon. With the consent of a South End crime boss, Benny (Clarence Williams III), they quickly rise in the drug game, while the leader of the group, Tristan, keeps his double life a secret from his clueless parents. However, as the 1970s pass to the 2000s, a police investigation threatens to ignite a violent feud among the tight-knit friends.

programme.title: Chaos
programme.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behavior on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

programme.title: State Property
programme.desc: Frustrated with being broke, "Beans" (Beanie Sigel) decides that the only way to grasp the American Dream is to take it. "State Property" follows Beans and his crew, the ABM as they take over the city, creating mayhem as their empire builds. Beans now struggles to maintain his family life, while bumping heads with opposing gangsters and the police. It all comes to a head when he cannot surpass the city's most notorious crew run by Untouchable J (Jay-Z) and Dame (Damon Dash).

programme.title: State Property 2
programme.desc: The gang war in Philadelphia is mostly centered around two rivals: Dame, the ruthless leader of the Umbrella organization, whose money and firepower have put him at the top of the crime world; and Beans, the one-time crime overlord hell-bent on taking back the city. The wild card is El Pollo Loco, a new player on the scene. His strategy involves teaming up with one side against the other -- but in reality, Loco has no plans to share Philadelphia with anyone.

programme.title: Who's Your Caddy?

C-Note forces the issue by purchasing the land adjacent to the golf course's 17th hole. As the club leaders search for a way to revoke his membership, C-Note realizes his family's honor and golf history are at stake, and digs in for the fight of his life.

programme.title: More Money, More Family

programme.title: Eve's Bayou

The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

programme.title: In the Mix

Frank then gives the DJ a job as his daughter's bodyguard, but, to the mobster's dismay, Dolly starts to fall for the smooth-talking Darrell. programme.desc: Ozzy, Sharon and Jack head to Hawaii for their vacation. Ozzy continues to be miserable for a while but cheers up following a private luau. Jack goes diving in a shark cage. programme.title: Kelly Interupted

Ozzy and Jack are convinced that Kelly's erratic behaviour and chronic illness are the result of drug use, but Sharon refuses to hear of it. Kelly eventually admits the truth to Sharon and enters rehab. Ozzy and Sharon don't believe she will stay at the facility for long.

programme.title: 28 Days Later
programme.desc: Kelly struggles to adjust to life in rehab, and frequently calls home requesting various personal belongings. She wants to leave, but Jack urges her to tough it out. Jack celebrates both his birthday and a year of sobriety. Kelly arrives home and becomes frustrated by the curfew and other rules she must follow.

programme.title: Charity Case
programme.desc: Sharon and Kelly plan a trip to Kenya on behalf of a charity organization. Ozzy doesn't want them to go, as he fears they will be kidnapped or contract malaria. Sharon also has second thoughts after hearing more details about the trip.

programme.desc: A 25-year-old fan wins a charity auction for the right to spend the day with Sharon. Sharon is touched by the woman's generosity and invites her to spend the night at the Osbourne home. Meanwhile, Jack must attend an online traffic school after getting a speeding ticket.

programme.desc: The family travels to Japan, where Ozzy is to receive the Legend Award at the Video Music Awards. Kelly also makes several personal appearances. One of the employees, Sam, meets with some family members whom he hasn't seen in years, but can only communicate with them through a translator.

programme.desc: A 29-year-old lawyer (Gillian Jacobs) and her lesbian best friend (Leighton Meester) experience a dramatic shift in their longtime bond after one enters a serious relationship.

programme.title: Flawless

programme.title: Detour

While drowning his suspicions in whiskey, he suddenly finds himself engrossed in a conversation with a volatile grifter (Emory Cohen) and his stripper companion (Bel Powley). As daylight breaks, Harper soon realizes that he's in over his head with this violent duo.

programme.title: Humboldt County

His long-standing life plan suddenly in question, the introverted Hadley stumbles through the streets of Los Angeles, until a one-night stand with singer Bogart (Fairuza Balk) lands him on an unexpected pilgrimage to Humboldt County, the marijuana capital of the West Coast.

programme.title: Ceremony
programme.desc: An obsessed young man (Michael Angarano) crashes the wedding of his older former lover (Uma Thurman) in a misguided attempt to reignite romantic sparks.

programme.title: Filth
programme.desc: A drug-addled, manipulative misanthrope (James McAvoy) begins to experience increasingly severe hallucinations as he tries to solve the murder of a Japanese student.

programme.title: Lemon
programme.desc: After Isaac's blind girlfriend walks out on him, his life goes into free fall, and he directs an unhinged staging of Chekhov's "The Seagull," attends the Passover Seder from hell, and attempts to woo a new flame.

programme.title: Four Lions
programme.desc: A group of young Muslim men living in Sheffield decide to wage jihad, and they hatch an inept plan to become suicide bombers. Omar (Riz Ahmed) and Waj (Kayvan Novak) have a brief, disastrous run at a Pakistan training camp, while Faisal (Adeel Akhtar) works on an unlikely scheme to train birds to carry bombs. Their ill-conceived plan culminates at the London Marathon with their bumbling attempts to disrupt the event while dressed in outlandish costumes.

programme.title: Swan Song
programme.desc: A retired hairdresser escapes his nursing home and embarks on an odyssey across his small town to style a dead woman's hair for her funeral, confronting the ghosts of his past and rediscovering his sparkle along the way.

programme.title: The Napa Boys
programme.desc: A mysterious individual known as "The Sommelier" leads a group of friends on a raucous road trip through wine country.

programme.title: Tapawingo
programme.desc: When an oddball mailroom worker finds out that his boss's son is being bullied, he forms a ragtag team of would-be mercenaries to protect the boy.

programme.title: Project Creep it Real Part 2

programme.title: Building a Custom K1500 Exhaust

programme.title: ProCharged Mustang

programme.title: Hot Rod LQ9 Cam Swap

programme.title: Prerunner Ranger gets a Custom Console

programme.title: Roll Cage Transforms Miata From Daily Driver To Race Car - Part 2

programme.desc: From a Flat-Head to a Chrysler Slant-Six, from a Ford FE to a boosted Chevy Straight-Six, Mike and Pat celebrate their vintage builds and how they turned retro into big modern muscle.

programme.title: Chevy K1500 5.3 LS Swap
programme.desc: LT hoists the tired 350 from the engine compartment for a budget conscious 5.3L LS.

It's all about knocking out the details that make this classic that much better.

programme.desc: We revisit the F150 Dream Truck and find out what bolt on upgrades actually do to your horsepower numbers, and we'll test it on the dyno.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - OCTO-DANCE! ROOKIE AND THE OCTOPUS
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happil

programme.title: Rookie Robot - GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie's photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn't stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer

programme.title: Rookie Robot - LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready - steady - and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BALANCE IN PINK - ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there's a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to

programme.title: Rookie Robot - BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.desc: Richard the Lionheart constructs a mighty castle on the Seine to dominate over his strategic Normandy lands.

programme.title: The Siege Of Alesia: Caesar's Greatest Victory
programme.desc: The fortress at Alesia falls to Caesar in his greatest victory, redefining siege warfare with Roman know-how.

programme.title: The Spanish Conquest
programme.desc: The Spanish Conquest produced 300 years of colonial rule, dividing Mexico with a class system still in effect.

programme.title: The War of Independence
programme.desc: The War of Independence charts Mexico's fight to break free from Spain after years of instability.

programme.title: Athens
programme.desc: See Athens rise from a village to Greece's pinnacle under Pericles, with landmarks that showcased democracy.

programme.title: Alexandria
programme.desc: Alexander the Great transformed Alexandria from a village into a thriving city with remarkable urban design.

programme.title: Tikal
programme.desc: Explore the rise of the Maya city Tikal, a major metropolis with 12,000 structures and towering pyramids.

programme.title: Rome
programme.desc: Uncover the architectural genius of ancient Rome, including the Pantheon, Nero's palace, and the Colosseum.

programme.title: The Mummy with Golden Jewellery
programme.desc: At Saqqara, Egyptologist Zahi Hawass hunts for Imhotep's tomb, uncovering ancient secrets and mummies.

programme.title: Secrets of Pharaonic Tombs
programme.desc: Zahi Hawass digs at Egypt's Gisr El-Mudir in search of the tomb of Imhotep near Djoser's Step Pyramid.

programme.title: Empire Builders: Inca
programme.desc: Investigate the mighty Inca Empire and its amazing accomplishments, including their awe-inspiring buildings.

programme.title: Inventing A City
programme.desc: Natives, Spanish missions, and more shaped L.A.'s growth, leading to its identity as the home of Hollywood.

programme.title: Bright Lights, Big City
programme.desc: Many diverse forces shaped L.A., bringing cultural richness and tensions, and making it a global arts hub.

programme.title: Tiger Vs Sherman: Tank Action At Rauray
programme.desc: Examine a battle that highlighted the strategies the Allies used to win the war.

programme.title: Who Betrayed Jean Moulin?
programme.desc: Search for the traitor who gave up the leader of the French Resistance.

programme.title: Thirty To One: The P-51 Mustang
programme.desc: Meet a pilot who single-handedly beat back the Luftwaffe in an iconic warbird.

programme.title: The Poles At Monte Cassino
programme.desc: Look inside a fearless battalion's incredible 2,000-mile journey to victory.

programme.title: Horrible look
programme.desc: Tomás finge ser un ejecutivo y le dice a Alicia que es el gerente de Filmo Imagen; Marcia y Alicia encuentran una fotografía de Patricia Manterola en bikini entre las cosas de Fernando.

programme.title: Totalmente enamorada
programme.desc: Adrianita cuestiona a Lola sobre su divorcio; Simón festeja a los niños; Luigi regaña a Jazmín por no hacer bien su trabajo; Efrén entra a Conceptos enyesado y con muletas.

programme.title: Intuición
programme.desc: Fernando intenta demostrarle a Marcia que no tiene ninguna amante; Eduardo le dice a Fernando que intuye que Marcia lo ama.

programme.title: Celebración cumpleañera
programme.desc: Omar le aconseja a Fernando salir con Lety para festejar su cumpleaños; Eduardo le dice a Fernando que Lety lo quiere y lo respeta, de modo que él debe valorarla.

programme.title: Última esperanza
programme.desc: José reconoce a Eduardo y permite el acceso a las del cuartel; Eduardo le pide al mariachi que cante; Marcia regaña a Alicia por coquetearle a Tomás; Lola y Efrén discuten frente a la juez.

programme.title: Apuesta inútil
programme.desc: Irmita le dice a Jazmín que Lola y Efrén deberán repartirse los bienes; Alicia se empieza a portar muy amable con Eduardo cuando se entera de que tiene dinero, incluso, apuesta con Luigi que lo va a conquistar.

programme.title: Cena de cumpleaños
programme.desc: Marcia siente que Fernando pone muchos pretextos para no ir con ella y le pide a Alicia que lo siga; Lety les dice a las del cuartel que saldrá a festejar con Tomás y le confiesa a Eduardo que está enamorada de Tomás.

programme.title: Invitación a cenar
programme.desc: Don Erasmo le reclama a Tomás por la cuenta del celular y se niega a pagarla; Lety se ve obligada a invitar a Marcia al festejo, pero ella se niega.

programme.title: Conviviendo con la familia
programme.desc: Omar y Fernando van juntos a un bar y Alicia se disfraza para espiarlos; Tomás juega billar con Sánchez y Rosales.

programme.title: Cita frustrada
programme.desc: Alicia le dice a Marcia que sospecha que Fernando fue a una casa de citas; Julieta y Don Erasmo le presumen a Fernando todos los logros académicos de Lety.

programme.title: Después de la fiesta
programme.desc: Román y un joven se suben al automóvil de Marcia y Alicia y reciben una rociada de gas pimienta; se arma un escándalo y todos son llevados a la delegación para aclarar la situación.

programme.title: Noche de amor
programme.desc: Fernando lleva a Lety a un hotel y hacen el amor por primera vez. Fernando no ama a Lety, pero sabe que fue una noche muy especial.

programme.title: Remordimientos
programme.desc: Paula María le cuenta a Lety sobre su noche con Simón; Jazmín se enoja con Efrén porque no quiere pedir la mitad de la casa de Lola; Fernando intenta explicarle a Lety que no pasó nada entre él y Marcia en el departamento.

programme.title: Por el bien de la empresa
programme.desc: Jazmín se niega a salir con Efrén, acepta la invitación de Simón y apaga el celular; Lety se atraganta al escuchar a Lola decir que la cuestionó Marcia; Alicia cuelga el teléfono cuando Román la reconoce.

programme.title: Compromisos obligados
programme.desc: Alicia se niega a empeñar sus joyas y su automóvil. Fernando pone a Carolina, Marcia, Luigi y Omar al tanto de las nuevas contrataciones. Luigi menciona la boda entre Fernando y Marcia, de modo que Lety se pone triste.

programme.title: Hermano despechado
programme.desc: Efrén le dice a Jazmín que pedirá la mitad de la casa de Lola; Ariel amenaza a Fernando con pedir la disolución de la empresa si no se casa con Marcia.

programme.title: Continúa el plan de boda
programme.desc: Fernando le declara su amor a Lety y le pide que se queden juntos; Martha le confiesa a Paco que la liposucción no le sirvió de nada, pero él le asegura que la quiere así.

programme.title: Artista de visita
programme.desc: Lety se emociona al leer la tarjeta que Fernando le dejó; Simón lleva a Patricia Manterola a conocer al personal de Conceptos y Alicia le avisa a Marcia de inmediato.

programme.title: Evento en el museo de cera
programme.desc: Alicia le aconseja a Marcia ir tras Patricia Manterola; Omar le dice a Fernando que Lety salió destrozada de la oficina. Fernando acepta que Luigi trabaje para Patricia Manterola. Marcia, Omar y Fernando viajan a Alemania.

programme.title: Escape del museo
programme.desc: Leticia y el Cuartel de las Feas asisten al museo de cera. Marcia y Alicia van para tratar de descubrir a Fernando con su amante y Omar le aconseja a Fernando seducir de nuevo a Lety.

programme.title: Dulce despedida
programme.desc: Alicia le sugiere a Marcia buscar a Fernando; Omar le ofrece su departamento a Fernando para llevar a Lety; Paula María se molesta porque escucha a Simón decirle a Celso que saldrán con unas chicas.

programme.title: La apuesta
programme.desc: Román y sus amigos interceptan a Alicia y le reclaman por sus mentiras; Lety le recuerda a Fernando sobre la llegada de Miguel y la apuesta que hizo con Román.

programme.title: Prioridades
programme.desc: Marcia le dice a Alicia que no quiere viajar con Fernando quien le confiesa a Omar que ya no quiere seguir engañando a Lety porque ella lo ama.

programme.title: Recocimiento merecido
programme.desc: Román le deja un recado por teléfono a Alicia; Fernando impide que Lety se vaya; Luigi ofende a las del cuartel, Cristina se molesta con él y lo obliga a que se las presente.

programme.title: Borrón y cuenta nueva
programme.desc: Fernando le da a Lety un regalo y una tarjeta donde le pide olvidar el pasado y volver a tener fe; Fernando y Marcia se despiden. Marcia invita a comer a Lety para sacarle información.

programme.title: Bolsa misteriosa
programme.desc: Simón se lleva a los niños y Efrén se lo reclama a Lola, pero ella le hace ver que Paco y Simón han sido mejores padres que él; Lety se niega a contarles a las del cuartel lo que habló con Marcia.

programme.title: Venganza cobrada
programme.desc: El chisme de que Fernando se peleó llega a oídos del cuartel. Los papás de Fernando le piden a Lety que arregle el regalo de bodas.

programme.title: La bolsa perdida
programme.desc: Omar urge a Fernando que encuentre la bolsa roja, pues si cae en manos equivocadas, se sabrá todo lo que han ocultado para salvar la empresa: Fernando le dice a Sara que la bolsa tiene muestras para laboratorio.

programme.title: Confusión total
programme.desc: Fernando confunde a Marcia con Lety por teléfono; Marcia le dice a Fernando que no lo quiere perder, Lety se convence de dejarlo ir.

programme.title: Falsas acusaciones
programme.desc: Alicia cuestiona a las del cuartel y culpa a Juanita de haber tomado la bolsa; Matilde intenta besar a Tomás durante la filmación, pero él le dice que se casará con Leticia.

programme.title: El Cuartel en acción
programme.desc: Luigi se va a Alemania para filmar el comercial de Sport Wing; Fernando le entrega a Lety un dibujo que le hizo; Lety habla por teléfono en clave con Teresita para explicarle su encargo.

programme.title: Los nuevos productores
programme.desc: Fernando deja su automóvil a media calle para ir tras Lety; las del cuartel se encargan de conseguir lo necesario para filmar el comercial; Raúl y Simón hacen la audición a las modelos.

programme.title: Cambio de giro
programme.desc: Se lleva a cabo en Conceptos la audición de las modelos en traje de baño, y Alicia decide que ella quiere ser la modelo del comercial y hará todo para conseguirlo.

programme.title: Equipo eficiente
programme.desc: Efrén busca a Jazmín y Fernando le pide a Simón que le ayude a encontrarla; Paula María logra que Pilar Zacarías, la modelo a la que quería contratar Luigi, se presente en Conceptos.

programme.title: Todo casi listo
programme.desc: El cuartel de las feas trata de complacer los deseos de Pilar para la realización del comercial y Lety le dice que Fernando tiene una doble vida.

programme.title: Batalla de supermercado
programme.desc: Don Erasmo le cuelga a Matilde; Alicia y Pilar chocan sus carritos en el supermercado; Lety le cuenta a Fernando por qué nunca aprendió a cocinar y él acepta que tampoco sabe.

programme.title: Romance interrumpido
programme.desc: Julieta le aclara a Matilde que es la esposa de don Erasmo, ella se disculpa y sale en busca de Tomás; Fernando le dice a Lety que se siente muy bien con ella y después atiende una llamada de Marcia.

programme.title: Fuera de la oficina
programme.desc: Fernando le cuenta a Omar cómo le fue con Lety; Alicia se queja con Marcia porque Fernando no la deja filmar el comercial y conseguir el dinero que necesita para pagar su deuda.

programme.title: Filmación caótica
programme.desc: Pilar se niega a filmar una subida en un caballo, un guardia impide que Alicia entre al club; don Riquelme y su acompañante le enseñan a don Erasmo a jugar golf.

programme.title: Cambios de último minuto
programme.desc: Gerardo le dice a Fernando que habrá problemas con el color del vestuario de las modelos. Ricardo llega a la locación y presenta a Francisco Riquelme como el cliente del comercial.

programme.title: Plan de diva
programme.desc: Fernando, Ricardo y Gerardo siguen el plan dictado por Luigi; el señor Riquelme y su acompañante llegan al bar con don Erasmo; Alicia espía el cámper de Pilar y Tomás la espía a ella.

programme.title: Sabotaje exitoso
programme.desc: Don Erasmo regaña a Lety por dejar que la abracen y le pide a Fernando que le ayude a cuidarla, pues al parecer anda en malos pasos y Tomás está en el club.

programme.title: Confesiones
programme.desc: Pilar le cuenta a su amiga que Fernando aceptó ser Pavel, pero que se dio cuenta de que ya no lo quiere; Lety cuestiona a Fernando y Pilar le dice lo que le confesó.

programme.title: No más mentiras
programme.desc: Lety intenta que su padre entienda la farsa entre Sara y Fernando, por lo que debe decirle la verdad que le ocultó cuando entró a Conceptos; Fernando le cuenta a Julieta cómo se unió el cuartel para que saliera el comercial.

programme.title: Miedo a volar
programme.desc: Alicia entra a la oficina de Fernando, pero él la corre porque sabe que solo quiere obtener información; Ricardo le da instrucciones a Fernando para cuando estén en Alemania.

programme.title: Afición futbolera
programme.desc: Fernando y Lety se hospedan en un hotel en Alemania; en la agencia de publicidad, Fernando y Lety se enteran de que ya se firmó el contrato con otra empresa.

programme.title: El mundial
programme.desc: Marcia escucha las voces de Toño de Valdés y Omar Chaparro y empieza a dudar de Fernando; Lety y Fernando reciben un boleto para el partido de fútbol.

programme.title: Viaje de ensueño
programme.desc: Fernando y Lety se la han pasado de maravilla. Sin embargo, don Humberto le reclama a Lety que no se comunicara con ellos y que no le haya enviado el video que le encargó.

programme.title: El sobre misterioso
programme.desc: Fernando le dice a Omar lo nerviosa que se puso Lety cuando la encontró en postproducción y él le sugiere ver el DVD de Lety, quien le encarga a Simón mandar un sobre a Londres.

programme.title: Sólo para mujeres
programme.desc: Marcia se enoja con Fernando porque siente que la está engañando. Alicia se queja con Rubén porque las del cuartel se van a un show solo para mujeres y él le recomienda que las acompañe.

programme.title: La madrastra
programme.desc: Efrén presenta a Jazmín con Cuco y Adrianita, quienes la recuerdan como La Demostradora. A pesar de los problemas con Lola, Efrén le pide que intente mantener una buena relación con los niños.

programme.title: Amor eterno
programme.desc: Alicia logra entrar al show solo para mujeres; Simón, vestido de mujer, es obligado a subir al escenario; los niños destrozan la casa de Efrén y Jazmín lucha con todas sus fuerzas para no enojarse.

programme.title: Desconcierto
programme.desc: Don Erasmo invita a Sánchez y Rosales a tomarse un trago; Lety se desconcierta cuando Fernando no le contesta el teléfono a Marcia; Efrén lleva a los niños a casa de Lola.

programme.title: Inseguridades
programme.desc: Fernando sale a un restaurante con Lety y ella piensa que le da pena que lo vean con ella porque pide una mesa en el lugar más íntimo. Por otro lado, Julieta le pide a la Virgen que proteja a Lety.

programme.title: Obligaciones que cumplir
programme.desc: Lety se niega a hacer el amor con Fernando y le propone que hasta que los dos sean libres para amarse lo hagan. Fernando decide no terminar con Marcia.

programme.title: Enojo y decepción
programme.desc: Marcia recibe un anillo de compromiso por parte de Fernando. Lety descubre la carta que le dejó Omar a Fernando con instrucciones para conquistarla.

She wants to get married and have children, but feels Joshua is not putting in the same amount of effort and she's had enough. She also believes Joshua continuously hides her from his family. Joshua says Ashley's constant nagging and accusations are the real cause of the turmoil in their relationship. Can Star Jones put the brakes on this runaway train of a relationship?

programme.title: "Dawna" Harvey vs. "Wayne" Harvey
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Dawna says she has no doubt her husband, Wayne, has been cheating on her. She says she's seen text messages, tracked his locations, and found his live porn. Now she's ready to end their marriage on the day of their 8th wedding anniversary. Wayne says he's never cheated on his wife and all of her "evidence" is in her head. Can Judge Star Jones perform a miracle and get this marriage back on track or will it end in shambles?

Amanda says their relationship is dying because Alonso has massive control issues and his only concern in life is his own personal gratification. Alonso says he is a dreamer with big ideas and goals and never receives support at all from the mother of his child.

programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Lizabet says her marriage with Chris is crumbling because he has put his failed surfing career over her and their family. On top of that, it seems Chris has been ditching his wife to spend time with a hot new "surf babe." Chris denies cheating with his protégé. He further maintains his wife knew what she was getting into when she married a surfer. Is there still hope for this marriage or have the tides turned? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.title: Cyn Wilson vs. Tyrone Wilson Jr.
programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Cyn says the man she met is not the man she married. She says she unknowingly entered a marriage with a man suffering from drug addiction. She says if her husband can't get sober, she wants a divorce! Tyrone argues he's been sober for the last 3 months and needs his wife to trust him. He says his wife is his soulmate and a divorce would be devastating. Will Judge Jones be able to cast this marriage one last thread of hope?

programme.title: Ronneice Reedy vs. Aubrey Murphy

programme.title: Lex Andrickson vs. Joseph Dale

Will Judge Jones be able to get these two on the same page? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Miriam says Tony has been taking advantage of her for the last 4 years and she's ready to cut ties. Can Judge Star fix this unraveling relationship or will these two only find true happiness elsewhere?

Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

Can Judge Star Jones bring the hammer down on this case and reestablish some order? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

He denies cheating and says Elizabeth is overreacting. Is Judge Star Jones willing to bet on this couple or will this relationship come up with snake eyes?

Gary says Earicka is not supportive of his career, and because she isn't perfect herself, she needs to adjust her expectations. Can Judge Star Jones help this couple put the pieces back together or is it not even worth the effort?

programme.desc: Today on Divorce Court, Shannon feels she is at a dead end in her relationship. She says her boyfriend, Zachary, is more interested in his conspiracy theories rather than focusing on their future together. She's given him an ultimatum...she wants a ring or she's moving on. Zachary says Shannon is financially irresponsible and uses his credit cards behind his back. Can Judge Star Jones plant some common sense into this relationship or is it time to move on with their lives?

Dex says Ashley needs to be patient with him and give him time to get a job. Can Judge Star Jones help straighten out this couple's priorities or is it game over?

April argues Joshua holds an archaic belief that a woman should always be submissive to her man. April says she is 20 years older than Joshua and she has no plans of changing her lifestyle. Joshua admits that he has no interest in being committed to one woman and wants to explore a polygamous relationship with April.

programme.title: Samantha Bracci vs. "Bob" Maillard

Can Judge Star Jones help this couple before their relationship goes up in smoke? Find out on the next Divorce Court with Judge Star Jones.

He believes Shanelle is cheating and noticed her receiving suspicious calls from other men. He's even seen another guy leave her home once.

She's had enough and wants a divorce. Cesar says his wife's mother passed away from Covid and she hasn't been the same person since. He says she's been inconsolable, and their communication has deteriorated. He says he wants to salvage their marriage, but it takes two.

He feels like she is hiding something from him...or someone.

As their relationship progressed, Doris says Marie didn't want to hold her hand in public, post their photos on social media or engaged in certain intimate acts. Doris believes she was an experiment, but Marie refutes this kind of relationship is very new to her and she needs time to get a feel of things.

programme.title: Brokeback Mountain
programme.desc: After four weeks on the road, Gino's airing his feet in the back seat as the guys cruise along a Texan highway. Texas is a meat lover's paradise, and Gordon is keen to show the Europhiles some of the best BBQ known to man.

programme.title: The Italian Job
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred start their road trip in Gino's homeland of Italy, where Gino needs help to pull off an event that is close to his heart. Gino collects Gordon and Fred in a campervan to begin a road trip they won't be forgetting in a hurry.

programme.title: Mamma Mia! Off We Go Again
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred travel to Greece to immerse themselves in the culinary traditions. The taste buddies go island-hopping, keen to learn more about the Mediterranean diet and how the country has one of the healthiest populations in the world.

programme.title: Go Greek! Clash of the Titans
programme.desc: The boys are in the Greek capital Athens in a vintage VW campervan. This is where high-concept cuisine originated and is still being re-invented, in a city known as the birthplace of democracy and the cradle of western civilisation.

programme.title: Desperately Seeking Santa
programme.desc: Gordon, Gino and Fred are getting together for another extraordinary culinary Christmas adventure. Gordon arranged a trip to the official home of Santa. They are going to Lapland to enjoy spectacular landscapes and meet Father Christmas in person.

programme.title: The Three Amigos
programme.desc: On a mission to taste the world's best breakfast, the three big egos Gordon, Gino and Fred are venturing out of their comfort zones crossing over the USA border into Mexico. They hope to stay out of trouble as they drive their bad boy transporter.

programme.title: What Happens in Vegas
programme.desc: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.

programme.title: San Fran Summer of Love
programme.desc: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.

programme.title: Saigon Noodles for Breakfast
programme.desc: Luke arrives in Saigon for a breakfast of iced coffee with condensed milk and a vermicelli noodle dish. Later, he visits his favorite Pho restaurant, then cooks up some spicy Chili Crab Claws.

programme.title: Bangkok's Night Market
programme.desc: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy.

programme.title: Malaysian Flying Noodles and Pork Bone Soup
programme.desc: In Kuala Lumpur, Luke meets the famous Mr Hung with a reputation for flying instant noodles and Mr Sou who cooks a hearty Pork Bone Soup with medicinal herbal properties.

programme.title: Jakarta's King of Street Food
programme.desc: Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food".

programme.title: Secret Family Recipies in Ho Chi Minh
programme.desc: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

programme.title: Vietnamese Pizza in Dalat
programme.desc: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

programme.title: Exploring The 'Wet Market' Of Nha Trang
programme.desc: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

programme.title: Fiery Chili Sauce in Hoi An
programme.desc: Luke is in the town of Hội An. He visits a family who has been making chili sauce for 5 generations, stops by the Historic Japanese Covered Bridge built in 1719, and meets a 4th generation blacksmith who is creating knives from bombshells.

programme.title: Seafood With A Bang, Here In Da Nang
programme.desc: On this stop of his Vietnam journey, Luke visits the bustling seaside city of Da Nang. Join him as he visits the spectacular Dragon Bridge, looks up some succulent shrimp on the beach, and stumbles upon a tiny fishing village packed with restaurants.

programme.title: Tasty Ant Eggs in Ninh Binh
programme.desc: After a long trip from Hue, Luke finally gets some rest in the scenic Ninh Bihn. Tag along as Luke meets with a local rice farmer, takes a canoe out for some crab hunting, and ventures deep into the jungle in search of a local delicacy- red ant eggs!

programme.title: Searching For The Banh Da Noodle in Hai Phong
programme.desc: Luke is in northern Vietnam- Hai Phong! This is the birthplace of his partner Lynne. Join Luke as he meets some of Lynne's family for the first time, and tries the delicious Banh Da Noodle- a tasty dish that Hai Phong is renowned for!

programme.title: Delicious Bun Cha in Hanoi
programme.desc: Luke's penultimate stop on his train journey is Hanoi. Follow Luke on his hunt for an iconic Hanoi dish, Bun Cha. Luke takes a ride on the Reunification Express railway, and visits the famous Hoan Kiem Lake for some delicious magenta sticky rice.

programme.title: Sipping Gin in Sapa
programme.desc: Nearing the end of his Vietnamese journey, Luke stops in Sapa, a hilltop region that he remembers from his travels fifteen years ago. Join Luke as he rekindles a friendship from his previous visit and learns about a local dish of dried buffalo.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Sinister 2
programme.desc: Hiding from her abusive, estranged husband, Courtney Collins lives in a rural house with her 9-year-old twins, Dylan and Zach. Young Dylan receives nightly visits from ghoulish kids who show him disturbing images of families being slaughtered. It's all part of the grand plan of Bughuul, the evil spirit who recruits innocent children to murder their loved ones. The only hope for his intended new victims may be a former deputy who's familiar with Bughuul's fiendish work from the past.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: Drop Dead Fred
programme.desc: An unhappy housewife (Phoebe Cates) gets a lift from the return of her imaginary childhood friend, Drop Dead Fred (Rik Mayall).

programme.title: Howard the Duck
programme.desc: In this film based on the comic book character, Howard the Duck is suddenly beamed from Duckworld, a planet of intelligent ducks with arms and legs, to Earth, where he lands in Cleveland. There he saves rocker Beverly from thugs and forms a friendship with her. She introduces him to Phil, who works at a lab with scientist Dr. Jenning. When the doctor attempts to return Howard to his world, Jenning instead transfers an evil spirit into his own body.

programme.title: The 'Burbs
programme.desc: Settling in for some time off in his suburban home, Ray Peterson's vacation becomes a horror when the Klopeks, a suspiciously odd family, move in down the block. Enlisting the aid of his paranoid buddy, Art, and his militia-man neighbor, Rumsfield, Ray sends his son and wife away on a trip while he investigates the Klopeks. When a neighbor disappears, Ray and his cohorts risk their lives to save their cul-de-sac from the clutches of evil.

programme.title: Grand-Daddy Day Care
programme.desc: A man has to figure out a way to make extra money when his father-in-law moves in.

programme.title: Kindergarten Cop 2
programme.desc: A gruff FBI agent goes undercover as a kindergarten teacher. He's there to recover stolen data, but first he'll have to learn to survive in the politically correct world of elementary education.

programme.title: About a Boy
programme.desc: A comedy-drama starring Hugh Grant as Will, a rich, child-free and irresponsible Londoner in his thirties who, in search of available women, invents an imaginary son and starts attending single parent meetings. As a result of one of his liaisons, he meets Marcus, an odd 12-year-old boy with problems at school. Gradually, Will and Marcus become friends, and as Will teaches Marcus how to be a cool kid, Marcus helps Will to finally grow up.

programme.title: Fried Green Tomatoes
programme.desc: On one of trapped housewife Evelyn Couch's (Kathy Bates) Wednesday nursing home visits, she encounters Ninny Threadgoode (Jessica Tandy), a colorful old woman who brightens Evelyn's outlook by sharing tales from her past. As Ninny recounts the exploits of her free-spirited sister-in-law Idgie (Mary Stuart Masterson), owner of a small Alabama café in the 1920s, and the bond Idgie shared with her friend Ruth (Mary-Louise Parker), Evelyn gains the confidence to change her own life for the better.

programme.title: Parenthood
programme.desc: Perfectionist Gil Buckman (Steve Martin) struggles with the deficiencies of his children, thinking they reflect poorly on his parenting -- and Gil's siblings only add to the stress of his life. One of his sisters (Dianne Wiest) faces difficulty when her teenage daughter (Martha Plimpton) becomes pregnant. Another (Harley Jane Kozak) clashes with her husband (Rick Moranis) when she asks for more children. Gil's immature brother (Tom Hulce) turns up as well, with a young son he can barely handle.

programme.title: Housesitter
programme.desc: Architect Newton Davis (Steve Martin) is distraught when his girlfriend, Becky (Dana Delany), spurns his proposal and refuses to move into the lavish house he designed for her. Davis, who cannot imagine himself living alone in the house, shares his tale of woe with Gwen (Goldie Hawn), a dishonest waitress he thinks doesn't speak English. Complications arise when Davis, on the brink of reconciliation with Becky, discovers that Gwen has moved into the couple's soon-to-be dream home.

programme.title: K-9
programme.desc: Michael Dooley is a cop who likes to work alone. But while working a case to bust Lyman, a notorious international drug lord, his boss assigns him a partner to assist. That partner is Jerry Lee, a drug-sniffing dog. At first Dooley can't stand his furry sidekick, especially since the dog seems to take pleasure in destroying Dooley's possessions. But when Dooley discovers that Jerry Lee's drug-sniffing skills are no joke, he warms up to the pooch.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: Crispy Duck Noodle Soup
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern transforms wild duck into a simple grilled appetizer inspired by Japanese tataki and then uses the rest of the duck to make open fire duck noodle soup with fresh egg noodles, lots of aromatic herbs, bean sprouts and a squeeze of lime.

programme.title: Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

programme.title: Mediterranean Grilled Filets and Salt Crusted Halibut
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern elevates California halibut, first with grilled fillets on saffron labneh with romesco and roasted cabbage. Then, he demonstrates a classic salt-crusted whole halibut, served with whole roasted cauliflower and a rich cream sauce.

programme.title: Smoked Brisket Hero
programme.desc: Pitmaster Jason Neeley (Pica Rica BBQ) drops by the backyard to share some insider tips for nailing the perfect brisket and helps Susie make pickled vegetables to go alongside her dad's hot potato salad! This is a must-watch for serious Pitmasters.

programme.title: Mexican Carne Asada Hero
programme.desc: Grill fatigue is a very real problem, but the globally-inspired menu of carne asada, tomatillo salsa, Mexican street corn, and Tex-Mex beans in this episode of Backyard BBQ Hero is sure to reignite the fire inside and get you outside cooking!

programme.title: Santa Maria Tri-tip Hero
programme.desc: If you love outdoor grilling AND flexing your skills by entertaining guests, the next Backyard BBQ Hero is required viewing. Fire up the grill for a show-stopping Santa Maria-style tri tip, a zesty salad, and an unbelievable dinner bread!

programme.title: Pulled Pork Party Hero
programme.desc: It's always kind of a party in the backyard, but it's really a party when Susie breaks out the smoker for some legendary pulled pork sliders, a homemade coleslaw, and a mac and cheese so creamy even the grownups will rave about it.

programme.title: Steakhouse Hero
programme.desc: Susie's bringing in a special guest so you can bring the steakhouse to your backyard! Christie Vanover of Girls Can Grill joins the fun and brings some fingerling potatoes to round out the ribeyes, asparagus, and a one-of-a-kind compound butter!

programme.title: Weeknight Family Dinner Hero
programme.desc: Susie from Hey Grill Hey teaches you how to make a full family dinner right in your own backyard in under 30 minutes! When you serve this grilled honey mustard chicken, creamed corn, and mixed veggies, you'll feel like a Weeknight BBQ Hero!

programme.title: Hickory Smoked Virginia Ham & Mint Juleps
programme.desc: Pat Martin gets a history lesson on the origin of American barbecue from "The Professor" Tuffy Stone.

programme.title: Bluefin Tuna Collars with Chili Pickle Relish
programme.desc: Pat Martin visits chef Adam Perry Lang in Los Angeles, where the pair cooks a prized catch castoff cut - Bluefin Tuna collars.

programme.title: Santa Maria Style Sirloin Steak
programme.desc: Pat Martin travels to a picturesque cattle farm in California's Santa Maria Valley, to hear firsthand from a young pitmaster who has uncovered the secrets of real Santa Maria barbecue.

programme.title: The Legend of Louis Mueller's Dino Beef Ribs
programme.desc: Pat visits his close friend Wayne Mueller, third-generation pitmaster of Louis Mueller's BBQ, to learn the ins and outs of his famous dino beef ribs.

programme.title: The Secret to Texas-Style Smoked Brisket
programme.desc: Pat and his buddy Leonard Botello use the flavors of the beloved native Post Oak to smoke a perfect Central Texas-style beef brisket.

programme.title: Catching Gulf Coast Redfish and Blue Crabs
programme.desc: Pat visits Houston to go Gulf Bay fishing with chef Chris Shepherd, hoping to catch some redfish and gather a side of blue crabs.

programme.title: West Tennessee Whole Hog
programme.desc: Pat Martin teams up with fellow pitmasters to showcase the rugged and nuanced tradition of whole-hog cooking, West Tennessee-style.

programme.title: Discovering Indian Lamb Kebabs in Nashville
programme.desc: Pat grills riverside with renowned chef Vivek Surti, crafting lamb kofta and chicken kebabs inspired by his Indian heritage.

programme.title: Searching for Oaxaca in Tennessee
programme.desc: Pat visits Edgar Victoria, known for bringing the street foods of Mexico City to Nashville, to do some live fire cooking out in nature as they prepare one of his favorite dishes - skirt steak tlayuda.

programme.title: South Carolina Peach-Glazed Ribs with Rice Middlins
programme.desc: When Pat's friends and fellow barbecue chefs, Bryan Furman and Dr. Howard Conyers, come to town, the guys dig deep into the tricks and traditions of one of Bryan's specialties: pork ribs.

programme.desc: Pat and his pal Jason Stanhope meet up outside of Charleston for a day of quail hunting and grilling birds over live coals.

programme.desc: Pat travels to the Emerald Coast of Destin, Florida, to join his friend Adam Evans on a spearfishing adventure, sourcing fresh fish to cook over live fire.

programme.title: Louisiana Style Crawfish Boil
programme.desc: It's Crawfish Boil Day on the show. Noah and Kev are making a gigantic Crawfish Boil; plus Smoked King Crab Legs; Grilled Rainbow Trout with Brown Butter and Grilled Lemon; and Kev's famous Red Beans and Rice.

programme.title: Southern Comfort: Oxtails, Collard Greens and Dirty Rice
programme.desc: We're cooking Smoked Oxtails; BBQ Oxtail Spaghetti; Cowboy Skillet Breakfast; Dirty Rice and Collard Greens.

programme.title: The Secret to World-Class Texas Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are making brisket 3 ways! They're pit-smoking a classic Texas brisket; showing you how to gussy up a pot of Brisket Baked Beans; and making a charcoal-grilled Vietnamese Brisket Noodle Bowl with all the fixings.

programme.title: The Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye
programme.desc: It's Steak Day! We're making a Smoke-Reverse-Seared Cowboy Ribeye; Steak & Eggs; Carne Asada Tacos with Refried Beans and Charred Tomato Salsa; and a Grilled Pork Chop with a Peach Glaze.

programme.title: These Smoked Turkey Legs are better than the State Fair
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.

programme.title: Every Kind of Rib: Dino, Fried, Smoked, Grilled and Glazed
programme.desc: It's Rib Day on BBQ Smokeout! Noah and Kev are cooking Dino Beef Ribs, Fried St. Louis Pork Ribs, Smoked Pork Spare Ribs with a Hennessey Glaze, and Smoke-Grilled Baby Backs. Plus we're making good old fashioned Dirty Cabbage.

programme.title: Why LA's Danger Dog is the Best Thing You'll Ever Eat
programme.desc: Kevin & Noah make their twists on some L.A. outdoor classics: Backyard Burgers 2 Ways; Pit-Smoked Pollo Asado; Grilled Mexican Street Corn and Bacon-Wrapped Danger Dogs.

programme.title: Beef Shank is the New Brisket
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are smoking a humungous Thor's Hammer; cooking up some Catfish & Eggs for breakfast; making a Grilled Salsa Verde; and putting on a pot of Mezcal Charro Beans.

programme.title: The Only Pulled Pork Recipe You'll Ever Need
programme.desc: Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

programme.title: Venison Paillard and Hearty Hunter's Stew
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern showcases venison two ways: a delicate grilled paillard with artichokes and Parmesan, and a rich, slow-braised Polish hunter's stew with kielbasa, mushrooms, and sauerkraut. Served with grilled leeks and coal-roasted potatoes.

programme.title: Minnesota's Foraged Mushroom Feast
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern explores Minnesota's forests for wild mushrooms. He creates a simple grilled mushroom salad, then hand-shapes cavatelli pasta tossed with golden chanterelles, butter, garlic, thyme, and colatura. He shares foraging and cleaning tips.

programme.title: Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
programme.desc: Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

programme.desc: Contestants will will have to put out a fire and rescue a dummy from its bed, lay in a pit while 3,000 scorpions are dropped on them. And climb a platform which flips end over end.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: This episode featured six celebrity contestants competing for charity. The winner would receive $50,000 for their charity, and the others would receive 10,000 dollars for their charities.

programme.title: Go Cart Chicken/Fear Factor Basketball/Water Rotisserie
programme.desc: Contestants must race a go-kart on a track over 100 feet in the air and must stop their front wheels between a yellow line and the end of the track. Round ball in stunt two as the players have to shoot basketballs from four spots. If they miss, they have to drink an 8-ounce glass of blended bugs

programme.title: Dog Attack/Gas Chamber/Car Carrier Drive-Thru
programme.desc: Stunt one is for the dogs as contestants make their way through an urban assault training building and press buttons to raise 6 flags. Along the way, they would have to get past 4 trained attack dogs. Stunt two is a gas as they have to stay inside a room full of CS gas (tear gas). The three contestants to stay in the room the longest would advance to the final.

programme.title: Heist Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's an escape from a helicopter cargo net, a crawl through a horrifying tunnel maze, and a heist from a submerged armoured car.

programme.title: Episode 18
programme.desc: This was part one of a two-part Championship edition. In Part 1 of the Fear Factor Tournament of Champions, the 13 players who had won before on Fear Factor during the second season competed again to compete for the Fear Factor Championship and 100,000 dollars prize. There are five stunts. The men and women will compete separately until the last stunt.

programme.title: Episode 19
programme.desc: Contestants will collect candy canes while sliding along a platform, gift gross food items with no take-backs, and swim under a flaming plexiglass grid.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Couples Episode - Players will be dragged by dune buggies, bury their teammates head in worms, and aim for a landing from a helicopter drop

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Contestants brave a dog attack, submerge themselves in a tank full of snakes and traverse a beam 100 feet in the air.

programme.title: Episode 20
programme.desc: Contestant's heads are placed in separate medieval-looking helmets (one filled with snakes the other with rats). In this stunt, one of the contestants will be wearing weighted boots. On "go" the contestants will be dropped into the water and the other contestant must dive in and release the clasps.

programme.title: Roach Coach
programme.desc: Four teams of two compete for $50,000 as they are locked in a cage and eat a meal of blood salsa and maggots

programme.title: Scorpion Tales
programme.desc: Four teams of family members compete for $50,000

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Contestants must jump between taxis, get in a coffin with roaches and escape, and grab money while being dunked in water from a crane.

programme.title: Disaster Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's facing hurricane wind and rain on top of a building, bobbing for cockroaches, and a river runs.

programme.title: Episode 26
programme.desc: Contestants will escape submerged tubes, get covered in snakes, and fight high winds in a ramp race.

programme.title: Barrel Rolling/Rat Transfer/Car Into Pond
programme.desc: Contestants have to stand on top of a large plastic pipe and use their feet to roll it across beams from one rooftop to the other. The four that complete move on. In the second stunt, going two at a time, the four would use their mouths to pick up dead rats from a table and toss them into a bucket behind barricades.

programme.title: Episode 28
programme.desc: Newlywed couples will have to tear apart a Fear Factor wedding cake filled with Beetles, Red Worms, Nightcrawlers, Super Worms, Fish Guts and Alligator eyes using only their mouths. In the couples stunt, contestants will be strapped into the passenger and driver seats. On "go," they will drive the car down a path and launch themselves off a ramp into a pond.

programme.title: Fire Fear Factor
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a helicopter net climb from a fireboat, shots of habanero followed by throwing flares, and a 60-foot fire slide into an ice-covered pool.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: This episode featured six celebrity contestants competing for charity. The winner would receive $50,000 for their charity, and the others would receive 25,000 dollars for their charities.

programme.title: Psycho Fear Factor - Part 1
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's a race out of being buried alive and escaping a swim tank filled with rats and snakes.

programme.title: Leeches and Tear Gas
programme.desc: n a special 2 hour Fear Factor five teams of 2 are bungied off a cliff while tied under a helicopter

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Players must get to a helicopter from a moving vehicle, clear disgusting tables with their face, and drive their car beneath a moving semi trailer

programme.title: Inverted Helicopter/Horse Rectum/Sky WalkerF
programme.desc: Contestants are tied by their ankles and hung upside-down beneath a helicopter. They would have to find which of three keys unlocked the lock to their shackles and pull a release cord to drop into the water below. It's horsing around for the second stunt as they have to eat horse rectum.

programme.title: Episode 17
programme.desc: Couples must drive blind and trust their partner, save each other from tarantulas, and meet in the centre of a lake while handcuffed.

programme.title: Episode 23
programme.desc: In this final couples stunt, both contestants will be riding on the back of an Ultraboat they each must grab hold of their own rope ladder hanging from a helicopter. Once touching down, contestants enter a trailer bed of a semi trailer and complete a small task to retrieve a car key, hop into a car, fasten their seatbelts and drive the car out of the back of the semi.

programme.title: Battle of Reality Stars - Part 2
programme.desc: Contestants take part in death-defying, stomach-churning stunts. This time, it's putting out a fire on a houseboat and escaping a box of bugs submerged underwater.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Contestants are dunked by a helicopter, transport disgusting items from a conveyor belt, and fight to stay inside a human hamster wheel.

programme.title: Episode 30
programme.desc: Contestants will free fall from a 300 foot building, splatter bugs on their face like a windshield, and try not to fall from a rotating beam.

programme.title: Car Crush/SnakeTank/Floor Drop
programme.desc: This episode has six celebrity contestants competing for charity. The winner receives $50,000 for their charity and the others receive $10,000 for their charities. In the first stunt, contestants sit in a car at the end of a line of junkyard cars. As a monster truck drove over the line of cars, they have to find which of six keys started the car and drive over a finish line.

programme.title: Episode 28
programme.desc: Models Episode - Players will 8free themselves from hanging in chains, pull alligator tails, and crawl between two helicopters with only a rope.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The contestant is sitting on a bicycle on top of a semi-truck that is traveling down a road at approx. 35 miles per hour. Using only their mouths contestants will have to pick-up tomato hornworms and squeeze the juice out of the worm and into a glass. In this stunt the contestant must walk on a 12 inch, 60 foot teeter totter beam from one building to another.

programme.title: Episode 30
programme.desc: Contestants are seated at a table behind six covered trays that conceal six different types of Fear Factor Sausages. For this "Best Friends" final stunt, both team members will be seated in separate stunt cars on opposite ends of a track, indirectly facing each other. On "go", both contestants must drive their car at towards their own pipe ramp.

programme.title: Helicopter Slalom, Piercings, Maggoty Cheese, Flag Snag
programme.desc: This was an extended 4-stunt episode. For the first stunt, contestants have to hang by their ankles from trapeze hanging from a helicopter that flew over 20 flagpoles. The have to release as many flags as possible. In the second stunt, they are strapped down and their left arm would be pierced by 10 needles which would get progressively thicker.

programme.title: Semi Finals: Part 2
programme.desc: Male contestants must identify disgusting items, then eat any they guess incorrectly; female contestants must retrieve dead feeder mice with their mouths while swimming in a vat of dead rodents.

programme.title: Heli Boat Drag/Bull Buffet/Window Washer
programme.desc: For the first stunt, contestants ride a raft behind a speedboat. They climb a rope hanging from a helicopter and release 6 flags before dropping 20 feet into the water. If contestants completed this stunt, they would win $1,000.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: In this couples stunt, the contestants will be standing on opposite platforms suspended 100 feet in the air. Contestants will have to siphon gross fluid (worms, crickets, cow parts, pig parts etc) out of 4 containers and into a large funnel.

programme.title: Semi Finals: Part 1
programme.desc: Contestants must drop out of a helicopter and race to pick up flags while swimming, and participate in a gross pot luck dinner. Then they must make their way through an airborne greasy maze.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Contestants get dragged by a horse, rest in a pit of rats and crawl on a car suspended 150 feet in the air.

programme.title: Episode 25
programme.desc: Contestants must stand on a truck as it drives through a tunnel, hit targets to avoid eating bugs, and dodge eing flipped by a tractor.

programme.title: Triple Beam Walk/Glass Walking/Magnetic Car Drop
programme.desc: Perched on the hood of a car suspended 100 feet high by a giant electric magnet, contestants must switch it off, sending themselves and the vehicle plummeting toward a target on the ground.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Contestants will be laying on their back bound at their ankles, waist, and one wrist to a plexiglass platform that is hung from a helicopter. Contestants will play a game to determine how much skunk, possum, rattlesnake and armadillo they will have to eat. Contestants will have to cross 4, 20-foot rotating beams placing flags along the way.

programme.title: Episode 27
programme.desc: Players must wedge themselves between two walls to avoid falling, eat live snails, and jump cars into trucks.

programme.title: Traverse Dam/Bee Headed/Water Coffin
programme.desc: Are you worth a Dam? Suspended high over a dam is a 350-foot long tightrope with flags attached. Contestants would have to cross the tightrope and collect flags while holding on to a higher tightrope for support. The two men and the two women to collect the most flags in 5 minutes would advance to the next round. Stunt 2 is a real Bee. The ones left are covered with over 200,000 honeybees.

programme.title: Burning Building/Scorpion Pit/Rotating Climbing WallF
programme.desc: It's hot for the first stunt as contestants climb a ladder, enter the fourth floor, follow a hose line to a room they put out a fire, rescue a dummy, and get out of the building. The two slowest are eliminated. In the second stunt, they lie in pit with over 3,000 scorpions.

programme.desc: Former friends sue each other for 10,000 dollars after an altercation at a bar where one woman stabbed the other two; claims of self-defense and counter-claims of harassment become further complicated.

programme.title: Runaway Groom
programme.desc: A mother seeks payback for wedding expenses from her daughter's ex-fiancé after he ended the engagement; he attributes the failed nuptials to the mother's interference and a contentious prenuptial agreement.

programme.title: Assault, Corgis, and Emotional Support Fraud
programme.desc: Former partners battle over competing assault allegations and the custody of their two beloved corgis, one of whom makes an appearance and charms the entire courtroom.

programme.title: Family Legacy at Stake and Rental DUI Delinquency
programme.desc: A woman sues her ex-partner of 25 years after enduring a forced eviction and alleged abuse in their shared home; a yoga instructor returns from abroad to discover that the woman who rented her car for three years had a DUI.

programme.title: Joy Ride Blow-Up
programme.desc: Teenagers fight over an unauthorized three-minute joyride that results in a blown engine and sizable repair bill; blame shifts to the sports car owner when video evidence of a high-speed freeway ride is introduced.

programme.title: Dog Breeder's Fight for Frenchie
programme.desc: In a canine custody battle, a man brings his dog breeder friend to court over Gizmo, a French bulldog; the dispute uncovers ethical concerns about animal welfare in the breeding industry.

programme.title: Road Rage Knife Fight (Part 1)
programme.desc: A woman sues for damages to her car after a heated altercation between her grandson and the defendant; tensions erupted when the grandson flipped off the defendant for honking at him for walking too slowly across the street.

programme.title: Road Rage Knife Fight (Part 2)
programme.desc: The conflict reignites the next day when a knife is allegedly brandished, triggering a frantic struggle; in the chaos, the car sustains damage when the two parties engage in mutual combat ending in the arrest of both young men.

programme.title: Birthday Bash Turns Brutal
programme.desc: A 31st birthday getaway to Tillamook, Oregon, takes a dark turn when a woman sues former friends for an alleged assault during a drunken argument.

programme.title: Pomsky's Day in Court
programme.desc: A woman sues her ex-boyfriend for custody of their rescue dog, Luka, who makes an appearance in court; the man alleges mistreatment of the pomsky by her teen grandson, citing incidents of physical discipline.

programme.title: Car Crush
programme.desc: A single mom from Vegas squares off against her dad's neighbor from Arizona over a disputed car deal.

programme.title: Breaking and Not Entering
programme.desc: A man sues a former friend for thousands in property damage after his window is shattered during a late-night confrontation involving an intoxicated girlfriend and a botched apology.

programme.title: Dangerous Passenger; Where Is Disney World?
programme.desc: A 40-year-old man sues his 23-year-old half-brother over injuries sustained in a violent altercation; a woman sues her niece for a Disney trip that fell apart after they mistakenly booked airline tickets to the wrong city in Florida.

programme.title: Buyer Seller Showdown
programme.desc: A woman sues a former acquaintance for selling her a faulty 20-year-old BMW, which broke down days after purchase; In retaliation, the man vandalizes the car, claiming she still owes money.

programme.title: Missing Cat Revenge and Sisterhood of Traveling Drama
programme.desc: A man sues his ex-friend for negligence after two cats entrusted to his care go missing; Friends sue their traveling companion, claiming she abandoned their planned trip to Brazil.

programme.title: Renter's Stabbing Standoff
programme.desc: A man accuses his former landlord of assault; he claims that she attempted to stab him with a broken mirror during a heated altercation; the man allegedly refused to vacate the premises amidst a rent dispute.

programme.title: Love and Larceny and MS Client Sued by Aide
programme.desc: An ex-wife sues her former husband for the $10K court maximum, alleging his negligence led to the theft of her Jeep; next, a home health aide sues her retired client, alleging unpaid wages due to the client's refusal to sign time cards.

programme.title: Hidden Horse Injuries
programme.desc: A businessman accuses a seasoned racehorse trainer of reneging on a deal for a horse; she argues that she returned the neglected animal due to undisclosed injuries.
